paras: Alopoglossus myersi is a species of lizard in the family Alopoglossidae. The species is native to southern Central America and northern South America.
The specific name, myersi, is in honor of American herpetoloist Charles William Myers.
Alopoglossus myersi is found in Panama, Colombia, and Venezuela.
The preferred natural habitat of Alopoglossus myersi is forest, at elevations of 800–1,300 m (2,600–4,300 ft).
Alopoglossus myersi is diurnal and terrestrial, foraging in the leaf litter of the forest.
